epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase successful document search rate by 40%
requirements: R1: Extract and index full text from uploaded PDF files (orders, extracts, reports).
R2: Expose a search interface capable of searching by text occurrence (e.g., surname) inside the document content.
R3: Provide visual feedback on search progress and empty states.
R4: Ensure the interface meets WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards.

slices.title: Define PDF search API contract
slices.jtbd: When implementing the search contract for this epic, I want to define the request and response shapes, so that backend and frontend can be built in parallel
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a search query parameter
When the client calls the endpoint
Then it receives a structured list of document matches
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce integration errors between frontend and backend to 0

slices.title: Implement PDF text extraction and indexing schema
slices.jtbd: When implementing indexing for this epic, I want to create the database schema for full-text search, so that documents can be queried efficiently
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a PDF file is uploaded
When the system processes it
Then the text content is extracted and stored in a full-text searchable column
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve 99% extraction accuracy for text-based PDFs

slices.title: Implement search API endpoint
slices.jtbd: When implementing the backend for this epic, I want to expose the full-text search query logic, so that clients can retrieve matching documents
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an indexed set of documents
When a search request is made for a surname

slices.sixSigmaMetric: Ensure 95th percentile response time is under 200ms

slices.title: Implement search UI
slices.jtbd: When implementing the UI for this epic, I want to build the search input and results view, so that users can visually find documents

slices.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve 100% WCAG AA compliance on search screens
